analysis.headline: Anthropic to give 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund
analysis.summary: Anthropic said it will commit 5% of its shares to a fund for the public good, ahead of an expected stock market listing. The Guardian puts the commitment's value at $48bn, a figure other reports on the announcement do not state.
